guardReason: Opens, comments on and closes the main-CI alert issue with gh; meant to run only from main-red-alert.yml.
description: Keeps one 'Main CI is red' GitHub issue in step with main's push and nightly CI: opens it on the first failure (naming gating and reporting jobs), comments on further failures, and closes it on the next green run. After a green run it opens one issue once main has been fully green for 7 days, the owner's condition for ending the sprint floor. After each main push run it also reports, on the same issue, a commit whose push run was replaced before it ran and that no other main push run covers; it triggers nothing.
